H1.statement: Existing RMSNorm CUDA kernels can be traced and simulated through Accel-Sim.
H1.evidence: Concrete, root-caused SIMULATOR_INCOMPATIBILITY: standalone nvcc compilation confirmed broken on this host for ANY CUDA program (minimal repro: #include <cuda_runtime.h> + empty kernel fails identically). accel_sim/installation_audit.json.

H2.statement: Accel-Sim reproduces directional ordering of RMSNorm block candidates.

H3.statement: Accel-Sim counters provide a plausible bottleneck explanation for RMSNorm's advantage.

H4.statement: LM-head GEMM/GEMV crossover can be analyzed using isolated Accel-Sim traces.
H4.evidence: Same root-cause blocker as H1; no LM-head trace attempted given the RMSNorm harness already demonstrated the underlying nvcc incompatibility is system-wide.

H5.statement: Isolated simulator evidence remains explicitly separate from real vLLM TPOT evidence.
H5.evidence: The evidence taxonomy (EvidenceKind.SIMULATOR_OUTPUT vs HARDWARE_BENCHMARK) and claim gate enforce this separation by construction and by test (test_e2e12_evidence_and_claim_gate.py, 21/21 passing); Claim B explicitly discloses 'simulator isolated attribution NOT available this slice' rather than conflating the two.

H6.statement: Existing MatMul-Bias-ReLU kernels can execute in an AArch64 gem5 setup.
H6.evidence: gem5.opt build failed on a missing m4 dependency; a concrete user-local source-build workaround was attempted and failed for an independent, diagnosed reason (gnulib/GCC-15.2 attribute-macro incompatibility). gem5/installation_audit.json.

H7.statement: gem5 reproduces at least the directional benefit of packed-B over row-major INT8.
H7.evidence: No gem5 binary was ever produced (H6 rejected).

H8.statement: gem5 identifies cache/memory/instruction effects consistent with real Pi measurements.

H9.statement: Target-specific A76 dot-product gains are not overclaimed when the CPU model cannot represent them.
H9.evidence: No gem5-based A76 claim was made at all this slice; Claim C explicitly states 'gem5 cache/memory correlation NOT available this slice' -- the absence of overclaiming is by construction, not by luck.

H10.statement: The evidence gate rejects or downgrades claims lacking real hardware support.
H10.evidence: 21/21 claim-gate tests pass, including a REAL downgrade demonstration using actual E2E-11 RMSNorm selector-vs-fixed-block numbers (mean ratio 0.9859 -> DOWNGRADE_TARGET_SPECIFIC). rejected_claims.json.

H11.statement: All simulator results are hash-bound to source, binary, config, workload, and tool version.
H11.evidence: No simulator results exist to hash-bind (both tracks blocked). The HASH-BINDING MECHANISM ITSELF is implemented and enforced (Evidence.__post_init__ requires simulator_config_hash+binary_hash for any SIMULATOR_OUTPUT record, tested), ready for future simulator evidence.

H12.statement: No existing three-family runtime or selector behavior regresses.
H12.evidence: 1935 passed (main venv) + 23 passed (GPU venv) = 1958 total, 0 unexpected failures, up from E2E-11's 1937 total (net +21 new E2E-12 tests, 0 regressions). All 7 generic-core source hashes unchanged from E2E-11.
